adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered MIC rows from Table 2 and Supplementary Table 1; worker-4 reconciled DBAASP assay/literature rows and preserved mixed CAMP/dbAMP cross-paper activity text as source_conflict; worker-6 replaced framework-test placeholders with source-reviewed final activity, database, mechanism, and review artifacts. The paper is accepted_with_cautions because no blocking source gap remains and remaining issues are preserved cautions, not open rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP linked text rows contain A. baumannii MIC subclaims supported by this paper and Staphylococcus MIC50 subclaims from earlier cross-paper annotations.
caution_findings.resolution: A. baumannii values are linked to primary activity rows; mixed rows remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figure 1 supports qualitative short-time killing and rank, but exact plotted CFU values are not text-tabulated.
caution_findings.resolution: No exact Figure 1 CFU values were fabricated; MIC values from Table 2 and Supplementary Table 1 drive the activity layer.

caution_findings.evidence_context: QCM and FE-SEM support interaction/surface-damage evidence; the paper states OmpA contribution was not fully understood.
caution_findings.resolution: Final mechanism records interaction and morphology evidence without claiming OmpA is necessary for killing.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP A. baumannii assay rows and literature rows are source_verified against article metadata, Table 1 sequences, Table 2 MICs, and Supplementary Table 1; CAMP/dbAMP mixed text rows remain source_conflict because they include Staphylococcus values not produced in this DOI.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 61 source-backed activity rows were recorded: Table 2 clinical/standard MIC summaries, 50 isolate-level Supplementary Table 1 MICs, and one qualitative short-time-killing record. No primary toxicity/hemolysis endpoint is reported in the local material for this DOI.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: QCM, FE-SEM, western/Coomassie, and discussion limitations support a bounded mechanism ontology: interaction and surface damage are source-backed; OmpA necessity is not overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original open ticket is closed after owner-layer repair; remaining limitations are explicit cautions and no major/blocking issue remains.
